# Be The Man

> Be The Man is a faith-based four-step system that helps Black Christian men with ADHD (diagnosed or still wondering) finish what they start. Created by Brian Greene, a pastor of ten years and certified marriage counselor who has ADHD. Scripture sets the standard and the structure makes it checkable: a written plan, a time and place for every commitment, a bad-day version so one rough week does not end it, and other men who check in. Step 1 is free. Tagline: "Built for the brain God gave you." Be The Man is a faith-based coaching and consistency system, not medical treatment, diagnosis, or clinical therapy for ADHD. It is not run by a church or a denomination.

## The four steps
1. The Calling: write who God has called you to be in one sentence (Habakkuk 2:2). Free.
2. The Commitments: no more than three commitments you can check each week (Matthew 5:37).
3. The Floor: a time, a place, a trigger and a bad-day version for each (Proverbs 24:16).
4. The Ledger: a weekly scorecard reviewed with other men (Luke 16:10, Proverbs 27:17).

## Pages
- [Home](https://bethemansystem.com/): what Be The Man is, the four steps, who it is not for, and FAQs.
- [How It Works](https://bethemansystem.com/how-it-works/): each step in depth, how a man writes his identity sentence and his three commitments, and how the bad-day version works.
- [Start Step 1 Free](https://bethemansystem.com/step-1/): the free Step 1 worksheet, The Calling. List your roles, ask what God expects of you in each, make it a Tuesday, write one sentence. 20 minutes, no card.
- [The Founding Cohort](https://bethemansystem.com/cohort/): six live weeks on Google Meet, Thursdays 7 to 8 PM Central, at most ten men, starting December 10, 2026 (no class December 24 or 31). Founding rate $197 for the six weeks, then $297. Full refund up to 24 hours before the first session.
- [The Club](https://bethemansystem.com/the-club/): for Founding Cohort graduates. A monthly live call, an optional accountability partner and the members area. $19 a month or $149 a year.
- [About Brian Greene](https://bethemansystem.com/about/): husband of eleven years, father of three, pastor of ten years, certified marriage counselor, has ADHD, grew up without a father in the house. Holds himself to six written laws: Clock, Source, Failure, Proximity, Evidence and Protection.
